title: applications implementing real session restore support are started on first Activity instead of where they were left
line: After logging in, restored apps open on the activity they were on instead of all piling onto the current one, and you stay on your current activity.
explanation: On Wayland, Qt 6 apps don't register with ksmserver, so the only thing that brings them back at login is Plasma's fallback session restore. Its save step stored only each app's id, and the restore step relaunched the apps plainly, so every window opened on the current activity. Also, when a new Wayland window is placed on another activity, KWin activates it anyway, which switches the user to that activity. On X11 those windows were never shown, so this didn't happen there. The fallback save now stores the activities of each app's window. The restore watches for the relaunched app's new window and moves it to those activities, skipping ones that no longer run. KWin no longer activates a new window that isn't on the current activity.

commits.message:
session-restore: restore windows on the activities they were on

The fallback session save only stored which apps were running, so after
logging in every relaunched app opened on the current activity. It now
saves the activities of each app's window and moves the new one there.

BUG: 348047

workspace: don't switch activity to show a new window

New Wayland windows were activated even when placed on another activity
by session restore or a window rule, which switched to that activity. As
on X11, such windows are now left on their activity without activation.

BUG: 348047

patches.diff:
From 3afac6af924d7b38551458fd07cc6b5ecd4fb93b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:41:38 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] workspace: don't switch activity to show a new window

New Wayland windows were activated even when placed on another activity
by session restore or a window rule, which switched to that activity. As
on X11, such windows are now left on their activity without activation.

BUG: 348047
---
 src/workspace.cpp | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/workspace.cpp b/src/workspace.cpp
index 1f4581dc0d..91d31104d4 100644
--- a/src/workspace.cpp
+++ b/src/workspace.cpp
@@ -994,7 +994,8 @@ void Workspace::addWaylandWindow(Window *window)
     m_windows.append(window);
     addToStack(window);
 
-    const bool shouldActivate = window->acceptsFocus() && !window->isPopupWindow()
+    // Like on X11, a new window placed on another activity doesn't make that activity current
+    const bool shouldActivate = window->acceptsFocus() && !window->isPopupWindow() && window->isOnCurrentActivity()
         && ((mayActivate(window, window->activationToken()) && !window->isDesktop())
             // focus stealing prevention "low" should always activate new windows
             || (!window->isDesktop() && options->focusStealingPreventionLevel() <= FocusStealingPreventionLevel::Low)
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: Dolphin was saved on activity "First" while "Second" was current. After the restore it is back on "Second".
With the fix: after the same restore, "Second" (left) stays current and empty, and Dolphin is back on "First" (right).

review.text: This does not actually fix Bug 348047: it fails the original reporter's exact repro steps (two Dolphin windows on two activities) as well as multi-window apps like Firefox, Chrome, Kate, and Konsole, and only patches plasma-fallback-session-restore rather than real Wayland session restore. Worse, the fallback watcher in restore.cpp introduces several races and lifetime hazards (unawaited async ActivityInfo, missing Wayland flush/roundtrip before exit, missing QThreadPool::waitForDone() for WaylandTasksModel icon threads, leaked pendingActivities entries on failed launches, and a race with Workspace::addWaylandWindow). While the KWin one-liner preventing activation of background-activity windows is a reasonable standalone idea for KWin maintainers to weigh against Force Activity rules, this pair of patches should not be merged to close 348047.
changes: Do not close Bug 348047 via a single-window-per-app WindowTasksModel listener in plasma-fallback-session-restore; address multi-window and real session restore activity placement in KWin's XDG session management / app integration instead.

If the KWin Workspace::addWaylandWindow change (checking window->isOnCurrentActivity()) is pursued independently, submit it as a standalone KWin MR with explicit maintainer sign-off on the Force Activity window rule behavior.

If any WindowTasksModel-based restore logic is ever kept in plasma-fallback-session-restore, it would need to wait for ActivityInfo readiness, flush/roundtrip the Wayland display before exiting, call QThreadPool::globalInstance()->waitForDone(), and clean up pendingActivities on failed launch jobs.
